title: leuzea carthamoides
intro: Leuzea carthamoides, commonly known as Maral root or Leuzea, is a perennial plant species native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to improve overall well-being and vitality. The health benefits of Leuzea carthamoides include its adaptogenic properties, which help to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and enhance physical performance. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
